autumn.label: Autumn
autumn.description: The default map. No special rules.

winter.label: Winter
winter.description: A Raging River divides forests, adding a forest-traversal barrier.

lake.label: Lake
lake.description: A central lake links coastal clearings; a ferry shuttles between them.

mountain.label: Mountain
mountain.description: Closed paths must be opened by spending cards; ruling the central Pass scores.

marsh.label: Marsh
marsh.description: Flood markers seal off clearings; flooded paths enclose forests.

gorge.label: Gorge
gorge.description: A dam separates forests; a bridge crosses without splitting them.

cards.note: Transcribed from the official therootdatabase.com hireling tarot card images (landscape). Verbatim card text.

promoted.label: Forest Patrol
promoted.setup: Place a Patrol warrior in each clearing.
abilities: Whenever any Patrol warriors are removed, place one of them on this card, not in the supply.
You may move, and then you may battle. —OR— Place all Patrol warriors from here into a clearing with any Patrol warriors.

demoted.label: Feline Physicians
abilities: Controller: Whenever any of your faction warriors are removed, you may spend a card matching their clearing to place those warriors in a clearing with your faction pieces, instead of your supply (like Field Hospitals).

cards.note: Transcribed from the official therootdatabase.com hireling tarot card images (landscape). Verbatim card text.

promoted.label: Last Dynasty
promoted.setup: Place all 5 Dynasty warriors in a clearing on the map edge.
abilities: If no Dynasty warriors are on the map, place all 5 Dynasty warriors in any edge clearing and battle there. —OR— If they rule their clearing, move all their warriors and then battle with them if able. —OR— If they do not rule their clearing, battle there twice.

demoted.label: Bluebird Nobles
abilities: Controller: You rule clearings when tied for presence (like Lords of the Forest).
Controller: Score one point for every three clearings you rule.

cards.note: Transcribed from the official therootdatabase.com hireling tarot card images (landscape). Verbatim card text.

promoted.label: Spring Uprising
promoted.setup: Roll the uprising die twice and place an Uprising warrior in matching clearings.
abilities: If no Uprising warriors are on the map, roll the uprising die and place an Uprising warrior in a matching clearing.
To battle the Uprising, the attacker must discard a card matching the battle clearing.
1st You must roll the uprising die.
2nd You must remove an Uprising warrior and all enemy pieces from a matching clearing. —OR— You must place an Uprising warrior in a matching clearing.

demoted.label: Rabbit Scouts
abilities: Controller: As defender in battle, before the roll, you may spend a card matching the battle clearing to use the higher roll and make the attacker use the lower roll (like Guerilla Warfare).

cards.note: Transcribed from the official therootdatabase.com hireling tarot card images (landscape). Verbatim card text.

promoted.label: The Exile
promoted.setup: Put the Exile pawn in any forest and the 3 Club items on here.
abilities: Anytime on their turn, a player with faction pieces adjacent to the Exile may place an item from their Crafted Items box on this card to draw a card and score a point.
Any number of times, you may exhaust one item here to move to an adjacent forest, and may exhaust two items here to battle in an adjacent clearing.
When done, refresh all items here.
In battle, you can roll hits up to the number of items here. For each hit taken, exhaust one item, or remove one if you cannot exhaust any.

demoted.label: The Brigand
demoted.setup: Place "R" items under the ruins as if the Vagabond were in play.
abilities: Controller: You may take an item from a ruin in a clearing with your faction pieces. (As Lord of the Hundreds, put it in your Hoard.) If you took the last item from the ruin, remove the ruin.
Controller: You may exhaust an item in your Crafted Items box (not Hoard) to take a random card from a player with faction pieces in a clearing with your faction pieces.

cards.note: Transcribed from the official therootdatabase.com hireling tarot card images (landscape). Verbatim card text.

promoted.label: Warm Sun Prophets
promoted.setup: Place a Prophet warrior in each clearing with a ruin.
abilities: If no Prophet warriors are on the map, place a Prophet warrior in any clearing.

1: Choose any player (even controller) with faction pieces in a clearing with a Prophet warrior. Force them to battle there, or force them to move as many pieces as they can from there to a clearing you choose and battle in the destination if you want. You choose the defender. —OR— Place a Prophet warrior in a clearing without one.

demoted.label: Lizard Envoys
abilities: Controller: You may search the top five cards in the discard pile and take a card of the most common suit except an ambush. You cannot count birds as other suits, and you decide on suit ties.

cards.note: Transcribed from the official therootdatabase.com hireling tarot card images (landscape). Verbatim card text.

promoted.label: Riverfolk Flotilla
promoted.setup: Place the Flotilla pawn in a clearing on the map edge and river.
abilities: The Flotilla cannot be battled or removed. In battle, the Flotilla can roll up to 3 hits.
1st: Each player with faction pieces at the Flotilla may draw a card.
2nd: You must move the Flotilla along the river, ignoring rule. Then, the Flotilla may battle.

demoted.label: Otter Divers
abilities: Controller: You ignore rule when moving to or from a clearing on the river.

cards.note: Transcribed from the official therootdatabase.com hireling tarot card images (landscape). Verbatim card text.

promoted.label: Highway Bandits
promoted.setup: Place 2 bandits, one each on a path without one.
abilities: When an enemy moves on a path with a bandit, they must remove one moving piece or damage one item (if Vagabond).
Controller: When you move on a path with a bandit, you may place a warrior in the destination clearing.
Place a bandit on a path without one, linked to a clearing with your faction pieces. If no bandits are in the supply, you may remove one in order to place it.

demoted.label: Bandit Gangs
abilities: If no Bandit warriors are on the map, place one in a clearing with your faction pieces.
Bandit warriors cannot be battled in clearings with their controller's faction pieces.
Place a faction warrior of the controller at each Bandit warrior; —OR— Place a Bandit warrior in a clearing with a faction piece of the controller.

cards.note: Transcribed from the official therootdatabase.com hireling tarot card images (landscape). Verbatim card text.

promoted.label: Sunward Expedition
promoted.setup: Place a foothold token and 3 Expedition warriors in any clearing.
abilities: 1st: Place a foothold token and up to 3 Expedition warriors in a clearing with no foothold. If no footholds are in the supply, remove one from the map in order to place it.
2nd: You may move, and then you may battle. —OR— Place a warrior at each foothold.

demoted.label: Mole Artisans
abilities: Controller: Whenever you craft a card with an item, you may reveal it instead of discarding it. At end of Evening, return the cards you revealed in this way to your hand. (You may end your turn with 6+ cards.)

cards.note: Transcribed from the official therootdatabase.com hireling tarot card images (landscape). Verbatim card text.

promoted.label: Corvid Spies
promoted.setup: Place 2 Spy warriors, one each in two clearings of matching suit.
abilities: 1st: Place 2 Spy warriors among any clearings with enemy pieces.
2nd: Battle in each clearing with any Spy warriors. —OR— In one clearing with any Spy warriors, the controller takes a random card from each enemy with faction pieces there.

demoted.label: Raven Sentries
abilities: Controller: In battle, you deal an extra hit if the battle clearing has buildings or tokens of your faction.

cards.note: Transcribed from the official therootdatabase.com hireling tarot card images (landscape). Verbatim card text.

promoted.label: Furious Protector
promoted.setup: Place the Protector pawn in any clearing.
abilities: The Protector cannot be battled or removed. Enemies cannot place pieces in its clearing.
1st: You must move the Protector, ignoring rule.
2nd: You must remove one faction warrior of each player (even you) in the Protector's clearing. (Do not remove hirelings.)

demoted.label: Stoic Protector
abilities: If the Protector pawn is not on the map, place it in a clearing with your faction pieces.
The Protector cannot be battled or removed.
Controller: Enemies cannot battle or remove your faction pieces at the Protector.
You must move the Protector, ignoring rule.

cards.note: Transcribed from the official therootdatabase.com hireling tarot card images (landscape). Verbatim card text.

promoted.label: Flame Bearers
promoted.setup: Place 2 Bearer warriors among any clearings (even the same).
abilities: If no Bearer warriors are on the map, place 2 Bearer warriors among any clearings.
1st In each clearing with any Bearer warriors, you must remove one enemy piece per Bearer warrior there, warriors first.
2nd You must place one Bearer warrior at a Bearer warrior or adjacent to one. If you cannot, place 2 Bearer warriors in any clearings.

demoted.label: Rat Smugglers
abilities: Controller: Any number of times in Daylight, you may discard a card with an item in order to move or battle. (You do not need to be able to craft it.)

cards.note: Transcribed from the official therootdatabase.com hireling tarot card images (landscape). Verbatim card text.

promoted.label: Vault Keepers
promoted.setup: Place 2 Keeper warriors and a vault building in any clearing with an open building slot.
abilities: If no Keeper pieces are on the map, place 2 Keeper warriors and a vault building in any clearing.
1st You may place a vault in a clearing with a vault or adjacent to one. If you cannot, place a warrior and a vault in any clearing.
2nd You may battle in each clearing with a vault. —OR— You may place a Keeper warrior at each vault.

demoted.label: Badger Bodyguards
abilities: Controller: In battle, you ignore the first hit you take. (This does not combine with other effects that let you ignore the first hit you take.)

cards.note: Transcribed from the official therootdatabase.com hireling tarot card images (landscape). Verbatim card text.

promoted.label: Popular Band
promoted.setup: Place 2 Band warriors, each in a different clearing.
abilities: If no Band warriors are on the map, place a Band warrior in a clearing with your faction pieces.
Enemies cannot move from a clearing with a Band warrior on the same turn they moved into it.
1st: Choose a clearing with a Band warrior. You may force any faction warrior in each adjacent clearing to move into the chosen clearing.
2nd: You may place a Band warrior in any clearing.

demoted.label: Street Band
abilities: Enemies cannot move from a clearing with a Band warrior on the same turn they moved into it.
Place a Band warrior in any clearing.

cards.note: Transcribed from the official therootdatabase.com hireling tarot card images (landscape). Verbatim card text.

promoted.label: Sunny Advocates
promoted.setup: Place 2 Advocate warriors each in a fox, mouse, and rabbit clearing.
abilities: If no Advocate warriors are on the map, place 1 Advocate warrior in any clearing.

Choose a clearing suit. In each matching clearing with an Advocate warrior, replace 1 enemy warrior with a warrior of your faction. Then, you must place an Advocate warrior at your pieces without one. If you cannot, place 1 Advocate warrior in any clearing.

demoted.label: Bat Messengers
abilities: Controller: After defending in battle, you may discard a card matching the battle clearing to make the attacker lose 1 point.

cards.note: Transcribed from the official therootdatabase.com hireling tarot card images (landscape). Verbatim card text.

promoted.label: River Roamers
promoted.setup: Place 2 Roamer warriors and 1 lilypad in a river clearing.
abilities: If no lilypads are on the map, place 1 lilypad and 2 Roamer warriors in a river clearing.
1st Controller: Craft using lilypads.
2nd Battle at each lilypad. —OR— Place 2 Roamer warriors in a river clearing. Place a lilypad there if it doesn't have one.

demoted.label: Frog Tinkers
abilities: Controller: Draw and reveal the top card of the deck. When crafting, you may spend the revealed card as a crafting icon of its suit. (Count a bird as a suit of your choice.) At end of turn, discard the revealed card.

cards.note: Transcribed from the official therootdatabase.com hireling tarot card images (landscape). Verbatim card text.

promoted.label: Prosperous Farmers
promoted.setup: Place 1 farm and 1 Farmer warrior in two clearings.
abilities: If no farms are on the map, place 1 Farmer warrior and a farm in a clearing with your pieces.
Players cannot score any points by removing farms.
1st: If you rule any farms, draw 1 card and place 1 farm in the clearing with the fewest warriors where able.
2nd: Battle at a farm, or place 1 warrior at each farm.

demoted.label: Struggling Farmers
abilities: Players cannot score any points by removing farms.
You may place a farm and a Farmer warrior in a clearing you rule. If you place both, draw 1 card.

marquise.label: Marquise de Cat
marquise.description: Industrial cats building sawmills, workshops, and recruiters across the wood.
marquise.adsetNote: Transcribed from the official therootdatabase.com ADSET (Advanced Setup) card.
adsetSteps: Choose 3 homeland clearings, each adjacent to one other.
Put 2 warriors in each of your homelands. Put 1 warrior in each other clearing.
Put the keep token in one of your homelands, not adjacent to an enemy homeland if able. Put 1 sawmill, workshop, and recruiter on the map, each in a different homeland of yours.
Fill your Buildings track with your buildings, except the leftmost spaces.

eyrie.label: Eyrie Dynasties
eyrie.description: Bird aristocracy bound by a Decree. Falls into turmoil if it can't act.
eyrie.adsetNote: Transcribed from the official therootdatabase.com ADSET (Advanced Setup) card.
adsetSteps: Choose a homeland clearing on the map edge that has 2+ clearings between it and enemy homelands.
Put 6 warriors and 1 roost in your homeland.
Put any leader card on your Leader Card slot. Keep the other 3 leaders face up nearby.
Tuck your 2 Loyal Viziers under the Decree column slots as listed on your current leader card.
Fill your Roosts spaces with roosts, except the leftmost.

alliance.label: Woodland Alliance
alliance.description: Forest revolutionaries spreading sympathy and igniting open revolt.
alliance.adsetNote: Transcribed from the official therootdatabase.com ADSET (Advanced Setup) card.
adsetSteps: Draw 3 cards and add them face down to your Supporters stack.
Fill your Sympathy track with sympathy tokens.
Put your 3 bases on your matching Bases spaces.

vagabond.label: Vagabond
vagabond.description: Solo wanderer with a satchel of items, completing quests and aiding (or sabotaging) other factions.
vagabond.characterPoolNote2: Per-character `module` gates which characters can be dealt: base (Thief/Tinker/Ranger), riverfolk (Vagrant/Arbiter/Scoundrel), vagabondPack (Adventurer/Ronin/Harrier). Each character's `meeple.appPath` is rendered when that character is the dealt Vagabond. Meeple SVGs by EwenDC (CC-BY-NC-SA 4.0), mirrored under public/games/root/meeples/.
vagabond.characterPoolNote: One character card is dealt face-up alongside the Vagabond setup card; the player uses that character.
vagabond.adsetNote: Transcribed from the official therootdatabase.com ADSET (Advanced Setup) card.
adsetSteps: Put your pawn in any forest.
Shuffle the quest deck. Draw 3 quests to deal out nearby.
Put 4 "R" items under the ruins randomly, unless a non-Vagabond has done so.
Put your assigned character card in your Character Card slot. Put the listed "S" items in your Satchel and on their matching tracks, as needed.
Put relationship markers for non-Vagabond factions in play on the Indifferent space of your Relationships (after setup).

characterClassMeeplesSvg.note: Vagabond character classes (cards). Useful if we ever model character selection.

lizards.label: Lizard Cult
lizards.description: Outcast lizards turning discarded cards into gardens and revealed-suit rituals.
lizards.adsetNote: Transcribed from the official therootdatabase.com ADSET (Advanced Setup) card.
adsetSteps: Choose a homeland clearing that is not adjacent to enemy homelands.
Put 2 warriors and 1 matching garden in your homeland. Put 3 warriors in clearings adjacent to it as evenly as possible.
Put 2 warriors in your Acolytes box.
Fill your Gardens tracks with gardens, except the leftmost space of the garden on the map.
Put your outcast marker on its Outcast side on any space of the Outcast box.

riverfolk.label: Riverfolk Company
riverfolk.description: Otter mercantilists selling services, mercenaries, and dividend funds along the river.
riverfolk.adsetNote: Transcribed from the official therootdatabase.com ADSET (Advanced Setup) card.
adsetSteps: Put 4 warriors among any clearings along the river.
Put 3 warriors in your Payments box.
Fill your Trade Posts tracks with matching trade posts.
Put your 3 service markers on your Services track, setting a price for each service.

duchy.label: Underground Duchy
duchy.description: Mole monarchy tunnelling from the Burrow, swaying Ministers to expand its actions.
duchy.adsetNote: Transcribed from the official therootdatabase.com ADSET (Advanced Setup) card.
adsetSteps: Choose a homeland clearing that is not adjacent to enemy homelands.
Put 2 warriors and 1 tunnel in your homeland. Put 5 warriors among clearings adjacent to it as evenly as possible.

Put your Burrow board near the map. Fill your Buildings tracks with your citadels and markets. Put your 9 minister cards face up on your Unswayed Ministers pile. Put your 9 crowns on the square spaces showing victory points.

corvids.label: Corvid Conspiracy
corvids.description: Crow plotters laying secret tokens that punish meddling rivals.
corvids.adsetNote: Transcribed from the official therootdatabase.com ADSET (Advanced Setup) card.
adsetSteps: Choose a homeland clearing. Put 1 warrior and 1 plot token of your choice face down there.
Put 1 warrior in a clearing of each suit. (Counting the previous step, place 4 warriors in total.)

hundreds.label: Lord of the Hundreds
hundreds.description: Warlord rats riding mood swings into burning, occupying, and humiliating their neighbours.
hundreds.adsetNote: Verified against the official therootdatabase.com ADSET (Advanced Setup) card.
adsetSteps: Choose a homeland clearing on the map edge that has 2+ clearings between it and enemy homelands.
Put your warlord, 4 warriors, and 1 stronghold in your homeland.
Put your Stubborn mood card in your Mood Card slot.
Put the 4 "R" items under the ruins randomly, unless this has already been done.

keepers.label: Keepers in Iron
keepers.description: Knightly badgers recovering and protecting lost relics, scoring through guarded prestige.
keepers.adsetNote: Transcribed from the official therootdatabase.com ADSET (Advanced Setup) card.
adsetSteps: Shuffle all 12 relic tokens face down. Put one face down randomly in each forest.
Choose 2 adjacent homeland clearings on the map edge that have 2+ clearings between them and enemy homelands. Put 4 warriors in each homeland.
Put any remaining relics, as evenly as possible, among any forests that are not adjacent to your homelands.
Tuck a Faithful Retainer card into each of your Retinue column slots.

lilypad.label: Lilypad Diaspora
lilypad.description: Frog newcomers seeking a peaceful Woodland home — but quick to harden under pressure.
lilypad.adsetNote: Verified against the official therootdatabase.com ADSET (Advanced Setup) card.
adsetSteps: Place 5 warriors and 1 Peaceful enclave in a river clearing, or one adjacent to the river if you cannot. This is your homeland.
With 2 players, remove the Frog dominance card.
Shuffle the frog cards into the shared deck. Put the Pond placard near it.

twilight.label: Twilight Council
twilight.description: Diplomats convening assemblies to redirect the woodland from violence to negotiation.
twilight.adsetNote: Verified against the official therootdatabase.com ADSET (Advanced Setup) card.
adsetSteps: Choose a homeland clearing. Place 4 warriors there.
Place 2 warriors in a different clearing.
Fill your Assemblies track with assemblies on their Closed side.

knaves.label: Knaves of the Deepwood
knaves.description: Forest miscreants raiding warriors and ransoming hostages back for victory.
knaves.captainPoolNote: Four Captain cards are dealt face-up alongside the Knaves setup card; the player chooses three to use.
knaves.adsetNote: Verified against the official therootdatabase.com ADSET (Advanced Setup) card.
adsetSteps: Choose 3 Captain cards and return the fourth one to the box. Collect their Captain warriors. Put the items shown on their Captain cards in your Stash.
Put 1 Captain and 1 Skunk each in three different forests.
Fill each Acclaim slot with 2 acclaim tokens.

referenceCatalog.intent: External asset references gathered from therootdatabase.com Workshop and the EwenDC repo. Drive viewUrls require auth; the static-export app cannot fetch them. Anything that needs to render in-app must be mirrored locally (e.g. /public/factions/<id>.png or .svg) with attribution to Leder Games and EwenDC (CC-BY-NC-SA 4.0).
referenceCatalog.adsetTextProvenance: Per-faction `adsetSteps` are transcribed from each faction's official ADSET (Advanced Setup) card image (CSS class `adset-img`) on its therootdatabase.com faction page, fetched 2026-06-14. These use the official homeland advanced-setup variant. Each faction's `adsetNote` records this. The law page at https://www.therootdatabase.com/law/advanced-setup/en/ holds the advanced-setup procedure and homeland rules (A.8) but not the per-faction step lists, which live only on the setup cards; it was used to corroborate the homeland-adjacency wording (A.8.3.II), not the individual steps.

uiContrastWarnings: vagabond #EBEBEB is near-white — clashes with the dark theme's light text token; player chip needs an outline.
twilight #4A2E1B / lilypad #385723 / knaves #595959 are dark — low contrast against the dark surface tokens. Best rendered via the meeple silhouette on top of the faction-coloured fill.

candidates.note: Primary laurel — wraps the leading-player head icon.

notes: All 13 factions have meeple SVGs (EwenDC) + PNG head icons.

ADSET card scans surfaced from Decimator85: only marquise, riverfolk, hundreds. All 13 `adsetSteps` are now transcribed from the official therootdatabase.com ADSET card images (see `adsetTextProvenance`).
Map / deck assets remain partial; not blocking until the wizard renders them.

Hireling module gating verified against Leder Games product pages (2026-06): hirelings ship in standalone Hirelings Packs, NOT the same-named faction expansions, and each pack supplies its own meeples (Law of Root H.3.3 — a hireling never needs you to own the matching faction). Mapping: Marauder Expansion = patrol/dynasty/uprising/exile; Riverfolk Hirelings Pack (riverfolkHirelings) = prophets/flotilla/bandits; Underworld Hirelings Pack (underworldHirelings) = expedition/spies/protector; Marauder Hirelings Pack (marauderHirelings) = flameBearers/vaultKeepers/band; Homeland Hireling Pack (homelandHirelings) = advocates/roamers/farmers. Do NOT regate these back onto the riverfolk/underworld/homeland expansion toggles.
